expected_live_motion_hu: A GUI profil ket egymast koveto, kb. 60 masodperces Room Cruise v2 futast indit. A robotnak elore dominansan kell cirkalnia, kb. 0.30 m/s celmaximum mellett siman gyorsitva/lassitva, akadaly elott lassitva vagy megallva, majd bal es jobb ivvel, szuk helyzetben rovid helyben fordulassal vagy recovery utan tovabbhaladva. Minden futas vegen determinisztikusan meg kell allnia. Kozvetlen PWM, legacy vagy szolgaltatasi mozgasi ut nem megengedett.

base_room_cruise_v2_gate.requirement: existing Room Cruise v2 live gate passes for every run

control_chain_integrity.requirement: Room Cruise v2 -> local navigation -> M3 TRACK executor, no legacy/service/direct path, EKF actual SSOT

control_loop_timing.requirement: 50 Hz target: p10 >= 40 Hz, dt/jitter p95/p99 bounded, loop-budget p95 bounded

left_arc_quality.requirement: arc turns requested direction, outer wheel faster, both wheels same direction, residual smooth

localization_sensor_consistency.requirement: same-snapshot encoder/IMU yaw rates agree and timestamp-correct EKF/LIDAR/IMU/encoder endpoint changes agree; no LOST/allow contradiction

measurement_sufficiency.requirement: required Room Cruise movement forms and at least two independent live runs are observed

motion_command_fidelity.requirement: actual linear/angular motion follows the limited resolved command within low-speed robot tolerance

motion_smoothness_comfort.requirement: PWM, linear command, and angular command steps stay within calm indoor motion limits

obstacle_avoidance_recovery.requirement: obstacle avoidance and recovery/continue after blocking are observed

obstacle_slowdown.requirement: front obstacle exposure is observed and command speed decreases before close range

repeatability.requirement: at least two runs with different start pose/heading/clearance and no large quality degradation

right_arc_quality.requirement: arc turns requested direction, outer wheel faster, both wheels same direction, residual smooth

room_cruise_behavior.requirement: sustained progress, no unnecessary standing, no rapid planner thrashing, no small-area patrol

safety.requirement: no safety/failsafe/non-finite event and clearance >= 0.25 m

start_stop_quality.requirement: start and stop are observed; measured motion settles within the declared 1 s window, then idle holds without unexplained PWM zero or creep

wheel_left_forward.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_left_reverse.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_right_forward.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_right_reverse.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal
